audience: print-on-demand sellers and merch teams that make shirts, hoodies and mugs in Shirtigo

useCases.title: Check the status of placed orders
useCases.text: List orders placed by the account, filtered by status. Open one order for its prices, delivery address and shipments.

useCases.title: Price a planned order before you place it
useCases.text: Calculate the total for existing products by SKU, with shipping and VAT. The tool places no order.

useCases.title: Browse the blank base product catalog
useCases.text: Search base products by category or SKU. Open one base product for its colors and sizes.

useCases.title: Review projects and the products in them
useCases.text: List projects, open one by its reference, and list the products filtered by that project.

useCases.title: Upload a print design from a URL
useCases.text: Upload a print design from a public image URL, then read its preview and processing status. No product is ordered.

useCases.title: Create an empty project for new products
useCases.text: Create an empty project that later receives products. No product is ordered.
